## Tidying

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
rdir <- "data/_raw"
expression_matrix <- read_csv(file.path(rdir,"Expression",
                                        "expression_matrix.csv"),
                              col_names = F) 
DLFPC_expression_matrix <- read_csv(file.path(rdir,"BrainSpan_DLPFC_expression_matrix.7z"), col_names = F)

Hippocampus_expression_matrix <- read_csv(file.path(rdir,"BrainSpan_HIPPOCAMPUS_expression_matrix.7z"), col_names = F)

# Reads the expression matrices with the first row as data rather than column titles.

Hippocampus_expression_matrix
DLFPC_expression_matrix
expression_matrix
```
